title: Nash-Bargaining HalpernSGD via Limited-Memory MultiLRSGA: A Two-Phase Optimizer for Multi-Objective Learning
summary: We propose NB-HalpernSGD via LM-MultiLRSGA, a two-phase optimizer for multi-objective optimization. The process starts with a competitive optimization phase by applying a limited-memory variant of MultiLRSGA, named LM-MultiLRSGA, designed to reduce the memory footprint of the original optimizer while preserving its rotational correction mechanism. It addresses multi-objective tasks by considering the competitive game associated with the original multi-objective problem, approximating a Nash equilibrium.
